AdverseEventSerious.description: Report-level seriousness filter, independent of reaction outcome.

AdverseEventSource.description: An explicit source; never probe the other family.

Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search five report headers by default with native totals in reports. Literal mentions do not establish incidence, risk or causation; reaction selectors use phrase match.

limit.description: Native report headers per page; default five.

reaction.description: FAERS MedDRA term phrase match, not exact equality.

received_from.description: Inclusive first FDA receipt lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

received_to.description: Inclusive first FDA receipt upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

serious.description: FAERS report flag: death or hospitalization; never a reaction outcome.

source.description: FAERS by default; no source fallback.

text.description: Literal drug text or MAUDE device generic-name phrase.

title: AdverseEventSearch
